literature.headline_zh: 诺如病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期诺如病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 在五起暴发病例中检测到了基因组相同的诺如病毒基因组群II(GII)。 [10.33321/cdi.2026.50.062]
诺如病毒在30.1%的儿童中被检测到,所有阳性样本均属于基因组群GII。在诺如病毒阳性粪便样本的儿童中,74.2%出现呕吐,显示出统计学显著关联。 [10.25248/reas.e24670.2026]
胆汁对GII.2 HuNoV具有类似的影响,但对GII.6或GII.4 HuNoV的HBGA结合和血清-配体阻断能力没有影响。 [10.1128/jvi.01338-26]
腹部X光显示肠气肿逐渐发展,最终确诊为IIA期NEC。腹部气肿在五天内完全消退,没有穿孔或临床恶化的证据。 [10.20944/preprints202609.2143.v1]
无论是小肠还是结肠来源的类器官,以及它们对应的细胞系,都支持了ReCV的强效感染。这些类器官包含了所有主要的肠道细胞类型,且两种细胞系均形成了紧密的屏障,其TEER值超过3,000 Ω·cm2,这显著高于LLC-MK2细胞(TEER ~ 100 Ω·cm2)。 [10.1128/jvi.00745-26]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Genomically identical norovirus genogroup II (GII) was detected from cases in five of the outbreaks. [10.33321/cdi.2026.50.062]

Norovirus was identified in 30.1% of the children, with all positive samples belonging to genogroup GII. Vomiting was present in 74.2% of children with norovirus-positive fecal samples, showing a statistically significant association. [10.25248/reas.e24670.2026]
Bile had similar effects for GII.2 HuNoV, but did not impact GII.6 or GII.4 HuNoV HBGA-binding and serum-ligand blocking potency. [10.1128/jvi.01338-26]

Environmental investigations identified microbiological contamination in household-stored drinking water and a household well, whereas no contamination was detected in the sampled PHED water supply source. [10.1186/s12879-026-14497-8]

Abdominal radiographs showed progressive development of intestinal pneumatosis, leading to the confirmed diagnosis of a stage IIA NEC. Abdominal pneumatosis resolved completely within five days, without evidence of perforation or clinical deterioration. [10.20944/preprints202609.2143.v1]

papers.title: Multiple outbreaks of norovirus caused by persistent transmission in a hospitality setting in Victoria, Australia, 2023.
papers.abstract: This report describes unusually persistent transmission of norovirus in a hospitality setting in Victoria, Australia. In September 2023, the Victorian State Government Department of Health was notified of six gastroenteritis outbreaks associated with events held at a single function venue. Genomically identical norovirus genogroup II (GII) was detected from cases in five of the outbreaks. No statistically significant association with illness was found for any food item. Information collected through staff interviews provided evidence of food handlers and wait staff continuing to work while infectious, likely resulting in sustained transmission through person-to-person routes as well as through potential contamination of the environment.

papers.title: Bile and capsid variation coregulate histo-blood group antigen recognition and serum neutralization potency in GII.12 human norovirus.
papers.abstract: UNLABELLED: Human norovirus (HuNoV) is a leading cause of acute gastroenteritis, with young children and the elderly bearing the greatest disease burden. GII strains cause the majority of HuNoV outbreaks globally, with host susceptibility influenced by genetic polymorphisms that regulate mucosal expression of histo-blood group antigen (HBGA) binding ligands. HuNoV viral capsid (VP1) diversity in residues adjacent to the conserved HBGA binding pocket selectively stabilizes ligand interactions. Additionally, select HuNoV capsids demonstrate bile-influenced conformational plasticity, further enabling HBGA engagement. Combined, these factors have the potential to enhance the breadth of binding of HuNoV to HBGAs, driving population susceptibility. Here we characterized two GII.12 outbreak strains that co-circulated cotemporaneously and were divergent at five key VP1 sites. Mutational analysis demonstrated amino acids at VP1 positions 373 and 392 coregulate HBGA ligand binding. Serological analysis demonstrated minimal antigenic impact at these positions. Broader GII comparisons demonstrated variable impacts of bile. Bile improved GII.2 and GII.12 binding to HBGA, in contrast to GII.4, GII.3, and GII.6. Further, bile reduced surrogate neutralizing antibody potency for GII.2 and GII.12 but not GII.4 and GII.6 strains. Collectively, these studies suggest that HuNoV bile-dependence is not a general feature of GII norovirus, but instead can be genotype or strain specific. These data inform how select GII HuNoV strains can modulate capsid residues linked to host-ligand and immune recognition, providing potential mechanistic evidence for continual viral circulation. IMPORTANCE: Human norovirus-host interactions are complex, influenced by viral diversity, host-ligand expression profiles, and the gastrointestinal environment. Periodically, outbreaks of endemic human noroviruses, like GII.12, demonstrate genetic diversity between viral strains of a genotype. Exploring this, two GII.12 outbreak strains were used to model the effects of genetic changes on the viral capsid ligand and antibody binding. Residue changes between the two strains modulated affinity for histo-blood group antigens that could be compensated for by addition of bile. Although bile improved HBGA-binding, it reduced serum and monoclonal antibody neutralization potency to GII.12. These observations demonstrate the balanced impact of bile-mediated viral capsid conformational plasticity in ligand recognition and potential immune evasion for select GII genotypes. Bile had similar effects for GII.2 HuNoV, but did not impact GII.6 or GII.4 HuNoV HBGA-binding and serum-ligand blocking potency, indicating that GII HuNoV strains potentially utilize multiple mechanisms to ensure host breadth and antigenic diversity.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how genetic variation in the viral capsid of GII.12 human norovirus influences its ability to bind histo-blood group antigens (HBGAs) and how bile affects this interaction. The research highlights that specific amino acid changes in the VP1 region of the capsid coregulate HBGA binding, and that bile can modulate this binding in some strains. Serological analysis showed minimal antigenic impact at these positions, while broader comparisons revealed that bile enhances HBGA binding for GII.2 and GII.12 but reduces neutralizing antibody potency. These findings suggest that bile-mediated conformational changes in the capsid may enable immune evasion in certain GII genotypes, potentially contributing to the virus's continued circulation. The study provides insights into the molecular mechanisms underlying host susceptibility and immune evasion in GII.12 norovirus, which could inform future research on viral adaptation and surveillance.

papers.title_zh: 胆汁和衣壳变异共同调控组蛋白-血型抗原识别和血清中和能力在GII.12人类诺如病毒中
papers.source_body_en: UNLABELLED: Human norovirus (HuNoV) is a leading cause of acute gastroenteritis, with young children and the elderly bearing the greatest disease burden. GII strains cause the majority of HuNoV outbreaks globally, with host susceptibility influenced by genetic polymorphisms that regulate mucosal expression of histo-blood group antigen (HBGA) binding ligands. HuNoV viral capsid (VP1) diversity in residues adjacent to the conserved HBGA binding pocket selectively stabilizes ligand interactions. Additionally, select HuNoV capsids demonstrate bile-influenced conformational plasticity, further enabling HBGA engagement. Combined, these factors have the potential to enhance the breadth of binding of HuNoV to HBGAs, driving population susceptibility. Here we characterized two GII.12 outbreak strains that co-circulated cotemporaneously and were divergent at five key VP1 sites. Mutational analysis demonstrated amino acids at VP1 positions 373 and 392 coregulate HBGA ligand binding. Serological analysis demonstrated minimal antigenic impact at these positions. Broader GII comparisons demonstrated variable impacts of bile. Bile improved GII.2 and GII.12 binding to HBGA, in contrast to GII.4, GII.3, and GII.6. Further, bile reduced surrogate neutralizing antibody potency for GII.2 and GII.12 but not GII.4 and GII.6 strains. Collectively, these studies suggest that HuNoV bile-dependence is not a general feature of GII norovirus, but instead can be genotype or strain specific. These data inform how select GII HuNoV strains can modulate capsid residues linked to host-ligand and immune recognition, providing potential mechanistic evidence for continual viral circulation. IMPORTANCE: Human norovirus-host interactions are complex, influenced by viral diversity, host-ligand expression profiles, and the gastrointestinal environment. Periodically, outbreaks of endemic human noroviruses, like GII.12, demonstrate genetic diversity between viral strains of a genotype. Exploring this, two GII.12 outbreak strains were used to model the effects of genetic changes on the viral capsid ligand and antibody binding. Residue changes between the two strains modulated affinity for histo-blood group antigens that could be compensated for by addition of bile. Although bile improved HBGA-binding, it reduced serum and monoclonal antibody neutralization potency to GII.12. These observations demonstrate the balanced impact of bile-mediated viral capsid conformational plasticity in ligand recognition and potential immune evasion for select GII genotypes. Bile had similar effects for GII.2 HuNoV, but did not impact GII.6 or GII.4 HuNoV HBGA-binding and serum-ligand blocking potency, indicating that GII HuNoV strains potentially utilize multiple mechanisms to ensure host breadth and antigenic diversity.
papers.abstract_zh: 未标注:人类诺如病毒(HuNoV)是急性胃肠炎的主要病因,婴幼儿和老年人承担着最大的疾病负担。全球范围内,GII型株导致了大多数HuNoV感染,其对急性胃肠炎的易感性受到调控黏膜表达组蛋白-血型抗原(HBGA)结合配体的遗传多态性的影响。HuNoV病毒衣壳(VP1)在保守的HBGA结合口袋附近的残基多样性选择性地稳定了配体相互作用。此外,某些HuNoV衣壳表现出胆汁影响的构象可塑性,进一步促进HBGA结合。综上所述,这些因素可能增强HuNoV对HBGA的结合范围,从而推动人群易感性。在这里,我们表征了两种同时共循环的GII.12 暴发株,它们在五个关键VP1位点上存在差异。突变分析显示,VP1位点373和392的氨基酸共同调控HBGA配体结合。血清学分析显示这些位点的抗原性影响较小。更广泛的GII比较显示胆汁对不同株的影响存在差异。胆汁增强了GII.2和GII.12对HBGA的结合,但对GII.4、GII.3和GII.6则没有这种效果。此外,胆汁降低了GII.2和GII.12的替代中和抗体效力,但对GII.4和GII.6株则没有影响。这些研究结果表明,HuNoV对胆汁的依赖性并不是GII 诺如病毒的普遍特征,而是可能与基因型或株种特异性相关。这些数据阐明了某些GII HuNoV株如何调节与HBGA配体和免疫识别相关的衣壳残基,为病毒持续传播提供了潜在的机制证据。重要性:人类诺如病毒与宿主的相互作用是复杂的,受到病毒多样性、宿主配体表达谱以及胃肠道环境的影响。有时,流行性人类诺如病毒,如GII.12,其病毒株之间会表现出基因型内的遗传多样性。通过研究这种现象,我们使用了两种GII.12 暴发株来模拟遗传变化对病毒衣壳配体和抗体结合的影响。两种株之间的残基变化调节了对组蛋白-血型抗原的亲和力,这种亲和力可以通过添加胆汁得到补偿。尽管胆汁增强了HBGA结合,但它却降低了对GII.12株的血清和单克隆抗体中和能力。这些观察结果表明,胆汁介导的病毒衣壳构象可塑性在配体识别和某些GII基因型的潜在免疫逃逸中具有平衡影响。对于GII.2 HuNoV,胆汁具有类似的效果,但对GII.6或GII.4 HuNoV的HBGA结合和血清-配体阻断能力没有影响,这表明GII HuNoV株可能利用多种机制确保对HBGA的广泛结合和抗原多样性。

papers.title: Systematic functional, genomic, and safety evaluation of food-derived anti-human norovirus candidate Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus YQ001
papers.abstract: Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus YQ001 is a yogurt-derived strain previously reported to bind GII.4 human norovirus (HuNoV) and inhibit viral replication in zebrafish larvae. Here, its in vitro probiotic properties and preliminary safety were evaluated together with whole-genome analysis. The 2.87-Mb genome (46.67% GC; 2757 coding sequences) shared 97.66% average nucleotide identity with L. rhamnosus GG ATCC 53103. L. rhamnosus YQ001 showed acid and bile tolerance, retaining approximately 30% survival after 3 h at pH 2.0 and over 40% after 4 h in 0.2% bile salts. During sequential simulated gastrointestinal digestion, L. rhamnosus YQ001 retained 35.98% survival after the gastric phase and 45.06% after the intestinal phase. L. rhamnosus YQ001 showed over 90% auto-aggregation at 24 h, while its cell-free supernatant exhibited DPPH and ABTS radical-scavenging activities of 85.17% and 76.35%, respectively. Antibacterial activity detected by agar diffusion was abolished after pH neutralization, indicating that the observed inhibition was largely pH-dependent under the tested conditions. L. rhamnosus YQ001 was non-hemolytic and negative for gelatinase and nitroreductase activities. Overall, the phenotypic and genomic findings support the probiotic potential of L. rhamnosus YQ001, while further strain-specific functional and safety evaluation is warranted.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估一种从酸奶中分离的乳酸乳球菌YZQ001的益生菌特性和安全性,该菌株此前报道可结合GII.4人类诺如病毒(HuNoV)并在斑马鱼幼鱼中抑制病毒复制。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究评估了乳酸乳球菌YZQ001的体外益生菌特性和初步安全性,以及其全基因组分析,未指定特定的研究设计或人群。
elements_zh.methods: 通过体外试验评估了乳酸乳球菌YZQ001的益生菌特性,包括酸和胆盐耐受性、自聚集能力和自由基清除能力。进行了全基因组分析以比较其与其他菌株的遗传特征。
elements_zh.main_results: 乳酸乳球菌YZQ001表现出酸和胆盐耐受性,在pH 2.0条件下3小时后存活率约为30%,在0.2%胆盐中4小时后存活率超过40%。在连续模拟胃肠消化过程中,其在胃部消化阶段后存活率为35.98%,在肠道消化阶段后存活率为45.06%。该菌株在24小时后表现出超过90%的自聚集能力,并分别表现出85.17%和76.35%的DPPH和ABTS自由基清除能力。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 表型和基因组研究结果表明,乳酸乳球菌YZQ001具有作为益生菌的潜力,尽管需要进一步进行菌株特异性功能和安全性评估。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为乳酸乳球菌YZQ001作为诺如病毒感染的益生菌候选菌株的使用提供了初步支持,可能对未来该领域的研究和开发提供参考。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于体外评估,未包括临床或体内测试,这可能影响研究结果的普遍适用性。由于缺乏全面的安全性和有效性数据,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 乳酸乳球菌YZQ001是一种从酸奶中分离的菌株,此前报道可结合GII.4人类诺如病毒(HuNoV)并在斑马鱼幼鱼中抑制病毒复制。本研究对其体外益生菌特性及初步安全性进行了评估,并进行了全基因组分析。该菌株的全基因组为2.87 Mb(GC含量46.67%;包含2757个编码序列),与乳酸乳球菌GG ATCC 53103的平均核苷酸同源性为97.66%。乳酸乳球菌YZQ001表现出酸和胆盐耐受性,在pH 2.0条件下3小时后存活率约为30%,在0.2%胆盐中4小时后存活率超过40%。在连续模拟胃肠消化过程中,乳酸乳球菌YZQ001在胃部消化阶段后存活率为35.98%,在肠道消化阶段后存活率为45.06%。该菌株在24小时后表现出超过90%的自聚集能力,其无细胞培养上清液表现出85.17%的DPPH自由基清除能力和76.35%的ABTS自由基清除能力。通过琼脂扩散法检测到的抗菌活性在pH中和后被消除,表明在测试条件下观察到的抑制作用主要依赖于pH值。乳酸乳球菌YZQ001不溶血,且不表现出明胶酶和硝基还原酶活性。总体而言,表型和基因组研究结果支持乳酸乳球菌YZQ001作为益生菌的潜力,但需要进一步进行菌株特异性功能和安全性评估。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal dynamics and multi-pathogen etiology of a norovirus GII-associated diarrheal outbreak in Bihar: a geostatistical analysis of localized spatial autocorrelation
papers.abstract: Diarrheal disease outbreaks remain a persistent public health challenge in Bihar, India, often driven by complex environmental and socio-spatial determinants. While traditional epidemiological methods describe disease burden, they frequently underestimate the underlying spatial structure of transmission. This study investigates the etiology and spatiotemporal dynamics of an acute diarrheal outbreak in the Jehanabad district, utilizing geostatistical frameworks to objectively discretize high-risk transmission foci. A rapid outbreak investigation was conducted in the West Kako region, Jehanabad, Bihar following a surge in acute gastroenteritis cases in July 2025. Mixed-methods approach integrating active case finding, molecular diagnostics for enteric pathogens, and environmental water quality assessment was employed. To evaluate spatial dependency Global Moran’s I statistics to case coordinates was applied. Subsequently, local spatial autocorrelation was assessed using the Getis-Ord Gi statistic with Inverse Distance Weighting (IDW) to identify statistically significant hot spots ( p < 0.05) of disease intensity within marginalized Mahadalit tolas. A total of 237 cases were identified, with the highest incidence among individuals aged < 20 years (55.2%). Environmental investigations identified microbiological contamination in household-stored drinking water and a household well, whereas no contamination was detected in the sampled PHED water supply source. Together with the observed spatial clustering of cases, these findings suggest localized environmental exposure potentially associated with point-of-use water contamination. Microbiological analysis revealed a multi-pathogen etiology, with Norovirus GII identified in 22.7% of stool samples ( n = 22) and Hepatitis A virus (HAV) detected in 5.6% of blood samples ( n = 18). Additionally, Escherichia coli was detected in 100% of the stool sample ( n = 16), which were not further screened for isolation of any specific strain. They were probably normal gut flora. However, possibility of presence of other common strains of E. coli causing diarrhoea in humans may not be completely ruled out. The geostatistical analysis confirmed significant global spatial clustering (Moran’s I = 0.1161, z = 3.64, p < 0.001). Localized hot spot analysis (Getis-Ord Gi*) identified high-intensity clusters (99% confidence, Bin + 3) specifically within Paswan and Manjhi Tolas. This study documents one of the first reports of Norovirus GII detection among patients investigated during an acute diarrhoeal disease outbreak in rural Bihar, highlighting a potentially evolving etiological profile. The application of localized spatial autocorrelation successfully transformed aggregate surveillance data into precise, statistically robust of disease clustering, supporting hypothesis of environmental exposure and subsequent person to person transmission rather than single confirmed outbreak source. By establishing a replicable geostatistical template for the objective discretization of disease clusters, this research demonstrates that integrating advanced spatial statistics into routine outbreak investigations enhances the precision of public health interventions in resource-constrained settings.

A rapid outbreak investigation was conducted in the West Kako region, Jehanabad, Bihar following a surge in acute gastroenteritis cases in July 2025. Mixed-methods approach integrating active case finding, molecular diagnostics for enteric pathogens, and environmental water quality assessment was employed. To evaluate spatial dependency Global Moran’s I statistics to case coordinates was applied. Subsequently, local spatial autocorrelation was assessed using the Getis-Ord Gi statistic with Inverse Distance Weighting (IDW) to identify statistically significant hot spots ( p < 0.05) of disease intensity within marginalized Mahadalit tolas. A total of 237 cases were identified, with the highest incidence among individuals aged < 20 years (55.2%). Environmental investigations identified microbiological contamination in household-stored drinking water and a household well, whereas no contamination was detected in the sampled PHED water supply source. Together with the observed spatial clustering of cases, these findings suggest localized environmental exposure potentially associated with point-of-use water contamination. Microbiological analysis revealed a multi-pathogen etiology, with Norovirus GII identified in 22.7% of stool samples ( n = 22) and Hepatitis A virus (HAV) detected in 5.6% of blood samples ( n = 18). Additionally, Escherichia coli was detected in 100% of the stool sample ( n = 16), which were not further screened for isolation of any specific strain. They were probably normal gut flora. However, possibility of presence of other common strains of E. coli causing diarrhoea in humans may not be completely ruled out. The geostatistical analysis confirmed significant global spatial clustering (Moran’s I = 0.1161, z = 3.64, p < 0.001). Localized hot spot analysis (Getis-Ord Gi*) identified high-intensity clusters (99% confidence, Bin + 3) specifically within Paswan and Manjhi Tolas. This study documents one of the first reports of Norovirus GII detection among patients investigated during an acute diarrhoeal disease outbreak in rural Bihar, highlighting a potentially evolving etiological profile. The application of localized spatial autocorrelation successfully transformed aggregate surveillance data into precise, statistically robust of disease clustering, supporting hypothesis of environmental exposure and subsequent person to person transmission rather than single confirmed outbreak source. By establishing a replicable geostatistical template for the objective discretization of disease clusters, this research demonstrates that integrating advanced spatial statistics into routine outbreak investigations enhances the precision of public health interventions in resource-constrained settings.

papers.title: Successful Nonsurgical Management of Norovirus-Triggered Necrotizing Enterocolitis in a Preterm Infant: What Is the Role of Immunomodulation?
papers.abstract: Norovirus infection has been increasingly recognized as a potential trigger of necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) in preterm neonates. Although previous reports have described severe cases associated with intestinal pneumatosis, bowel ischemia, and the need for surgical intervention, the clinical spectrum of Norovirus-related intestinal disease remains poorly defined. We report the case of a 29-week gestational age preterm infant who developed abdominal distension on the 35th day of life. Stool reverse transcriptase polymerase chain reaction confirmed Norovirus infection. Abdominal radiographs showed progressive development of intestinal pneumatosis, leading to the confirmed diagnosis of a stage IIA NEC. Abdominal pneumatosis resolved completely within five days, without evidence of perforation or clinical deterioration. The infant received only supportive therapy and intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG). This case highlighted the heterogeneous clinical spectrum of Norovirus-associated intestinal involvement in preterm infants and the possible protective and immunomodulatory role of the IVIG.

analysis.study_design_and_population: We report the case of a 29-week gestational age preterm infant who developed abdominal distension on the 35th day of life.
analysis.methods: Stool reverse transcriptase polymerase chain reaction confirmed Norovirus infection. The infant received only supportive therapy and intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG).

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings cautiously inform the potential role of immunomodulation in managing Norovirus-triggered NEC in preterm infants and suggest the need for further research into the clinical spectrum of Norovirus-related intestinal disease.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a preterm infant with Norovirus infection who developed stage IIA necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) but was successfully managed with supportive therapy and intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG). The study highlights the heterogeneous clinical spectrum of Norovirus-associated intestinal disease in preterm infants and suggests a possible protective role of IVIG. The findings contribute to understanding the potential impact of immunomodulation in managing Norovirus-triggered NEC, though the study is limited to a single case and lacks broader statistical analysis. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the observational nature of the case report and the absence of comparative data.

papers.title_zh: 早产儿诺如病毒引发的坏死性小肠结肠炎非手术成功管理:免疫调节在其中起什么作用?
papers.source_body_en: Norovirus infection has been increasingly recognized as a potential trigger of necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) in preterm neonates. Although previous reports have described severe cases associated with intestinal pneumatosis, bowel ischemia, and the need for surgical intervention, the clinical spectrum of Norovirus-related intestinal disease remains poorly defined. We report the case of a 29-week gestational age preterm infant who developed abdominal distension on the 35th day of life. Stool reverse transcriptase polymerase chain reaction confirmed Norovirus infection. Abdominal radiographs showed progressive development of intestinal pneumatosis, leading to the confirmed diagnosis of a stage IIA NEC. Abdominal pneumatosis resolved completely within five days, without evidence of perforation or clinical deterioration. The infant received only supportive therapy and intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG). This case highlighted the heterogeneous clinical spectrum of Norovirus-associated intestinal involvement in preterm infants and the possible protective and immunomodulatory role of the IVIG.
papers.abstract_zh: 诺如病毒感染已被越来越多地认识到可能是早产新生儿坏死性小肠结肠炎(NEC)的一个潜在诱因。尽管之前有报告描述了与肠气肿、肠道缺血和需要手术干预相关的严重病例,但诺如病毒相关肠道疾病的临床表现仍不明确。我们报告了一例29周胎龄的早产儿,在出生后第35天出现腹胀。粪便逆转录酶聚合酶链反应(RT-PCR)确认了诺如病毒感染。腹部X光显示肠气肿逐渐发展,最终确诊为IIA期NEC。腹部气肿在五天内完全消退,没有穿孔或临床恶化的证据。该婴儿仅接受了支持性治疗和静脉注射免疫球蛋白(IVIG)。该病例突显了诺如病毒在早产儿肠道受累中的异质性临床表现,并提示IVIG可能具有保护作用和免疫调节作用。

papers.title: Norovirus in hospitalized children with acute diarrhea after rotavirus vaccine introduction in Recife
papers.abstract: Objective: To determine the frequency of norovirus and its genogroups in fecal samples of children under two years of age, hospitalized for acute diarrhea in northeastern Brazil. Methods: A cross-sectional, prospective study between February 2007 and April 2010. Acute diarrhea was defined as the presence of three or more stools of decreased consistency or the presence of at least one stool with visibly present blood within a 24-hour period, lasting up to 14 days. Stool samples were analyzed using RT-PCR. Results: A total of 103 children were studied. Norovirus was identified in 30.1% of the children, with genogroup GII identified in 100% of the positive samples. Vomiting was present in 74.2% of children with norovirus-positive fecal samples, representing a statistically significant association. Conclusion: Norovirus was identified as a major enteric pathogen, detected in one-third of hospitalized children with acute diarrhea. The significant association with vomiting reinforces its distinct clinical role in pediatric gastroenteritis. These findings underscore the need for continued surveillance and further research to understand the evolving epidemiology of viral gastroenteritis in the post-rotavirus vaccine period in Brazil.

papers.title: Development of rhesus macaque enteroids and enteroid-derived cell lines for enteric calicivirus infections.
papers.abstract: Recoviruses (ReCV) serve as valuable surrogates for fastidious human noroviruses (HuNoV). Although HuNoVs can be propagated in small intestinal enteroids, this system has several limitations, including low replication efficiency and an inability to sustain continuous propagation for generating infectious virus stocks beyond certain strains, such as GII.3. In contrast, ReCVs can be efficiently propagated in conventional cell lines (e.g., LLC-MK2), which has significantly advanced understanding of their biological characteristics. As a result, ReCVs are widely used as HuNoV surrogates. However, a physiologically relevant ReCV propagation system that closely mimics HuNoV enteroid cultures has not yet been described. Here, we report the establishment of intestinal stem cell-derived rhesus macaque enteroid lines representing both the small intestine and colon, along with two enteroid-derived cell lines. We further characterize these systems and evaluate their susceptibility to infection with three diverse ReCV isolates. Both small intestine- and colon-derived enteroids, as well as their corresponding cell lines, supported robust ReCV infection. The enteroids contained all major intestinal cell types. The duodenum-derived cell line comprised enteroendocrine cells (chromogranin A) and absorptive enterocytes (villin), whereas the colon-derived cell line included enteroendocrine cells and goblet cells (MUC2). Importantly, both cell lines formed tight barriers (transepithelial electrical resistance [TEER] > 3,000 Ω·cm2), making them far superior to LLC-MK2 cells (TEER ~ 100 Ω·cm2) for studies of viral entry and pathogenesis. The rhesus enteroids and intestinal cell lines developed in this study will enable comparative studies of HuNoV and ReCV replication in a physiologically relevant system and may have direct applications for culturing HuNoVs.IMPORTANCEHuman intestinal stem cell-derived enteroids have enabled the propagation of human noroviruses; however, this system has several important limitations, including high cost, low replication efficiency, and (except for a recent report for GII.3 human norovirus) the inability to sustain continuous virus propagation for the generation of infectious virus stocks. As a result, research still relies on human norovirus-containing clinical samples as the primary virus source. Here, we developed host-specific rhesus macaque enteroid cultures and two enteroid-derived cell lines that support robust recovirus replication. Studying recovirus replication in rhesus enteroids may help overcome key limitations of the human norovirus enteroid cultures. Moreover, because both natural and experimental human norovirus infections have been described in rhesus macaques, the rhesus enteroids and enteroid-derived cell lines described in this study may be directly applicable to human norovirus cultivation.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the limitations of current human norovirus (HuNoV) propagation systems by developing a physiologically relevant model using rhesus macaque enteroids and enteroid-derived cell lines. Recoviruses (ReCV) are used as surrogates for HuNoVs due to their easier propagation in conventional cell lines.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved the development of intestinal stem cell-derived rhesus macaque enteroid lines from both the small intestine and colon, along with two enteroid-derived cell lines. These systems were evaluated for their susceptibility to infection with three diverse ReCV isolates.
analysis.methods: The researchers established rhesus macaque enteroid cultures and derived cell lines from them. They characterized these systems by assessing their cellular composition and evaluated their ability to support ReCV infection through measures such as transepithelial electrical resistance (TEER).
analysis.main_results: Both small intestine- and colon-derived enteroids, as well as their corresponding cell lines, supported robust ReCV infection. The enteroids contained all major intestinal cell types, and both cell lines formed tight barriers with TEER values exceeding 3,000 Ω·cm2, which is significantly higher than LLC-MK2 cells (TEER ~ 100 Ω·cm2).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that these rhesus enteroid systems provide a more physiologically relevant platform for studying ReCV replication compared to conventional cell lines. This development may help overcome key limitations of human norovirus enteroid cultures.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may enable comparative studies of HuNoV and ReCV replication in a more physiologically relevant system, potentially leading to improved methods for culturing HuNoVs and advancing research on norovirus infections.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study does not address the limitations of the human norovirus enteroid system directly, as it focuses on ReCV. However, the evidence is strong, as it demonstrates the successful establishment and characterization of rhesus enteroid models that support ReCV infection.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to develop a physiologically relevant model for studying norovirus infections by creating rhesus macaque enteroid cultures and derived cell lines. The researchers established these systems and evaluated their susceptibility to infection with three ReCV isolates. Both enteroids and cell lines supported robust ReCV replication, with tight barriers formed by the cell lines, making them superior to conventional cell lines like LLC-MK2. The findings suggest that these models could help overcome limitations in human norovirus research and may have direct applications for culturing HuNoVs. The study provides a strong foundation for future research on norovirus biology and pathogenesis, though it does not directly address the limitations of human norovirus enteroid systems.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the limitations of current human norovirus (HuNoV) propagation systems by developing a physiologically relevant model using rhesus macaque enteroids and enteroid-derived cell lines. Recoviruses (ReCV) are used as surrogates for HuNoVs due to their easier propagation in conventional cell lines.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study involved the development of intestinal stem cell-derived rhesus macaque enteroid lines from both the small intestine and colon, along with two enteroid-derived cell lines. These systems were evaluated for their susceptibility to infection with three diverse ReCV isolates.
analysis_en.methods: The researchers established rhesus macaque enteroid cultures and derived cell lines from them. They characterized these systems by assessing their cellular composition and evaluated their ability to support ReCV infection through measures such as transepithelial electrical resistance (TEER).
analysis_en.main_results: Both small intestine- and colon-derived enteroids, as well as their corresponding cell lines, supported robust ReCV infection. The enteroids contained all major intestinal cell types, and both cell lines formed tight barriers with TEER values exceeding 3,000 Ω·cm2, which is significantly higher than LLC-MK2 cells (TEER ~ 100 Ω·cm2).
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that these rhesus enteroid systems provide a more physiologically relevant platform for studying ReCV replication compared to conventional cell lines. This development may help overcome key limitations of human norovirus enteroid cultures.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may enable comparative studies of HuNoV and ReCV replication in a more physiologically relevant system, potentially leading to improved methods for culturing HuNoVs and advancing research on norovirus infections.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study does not address the limitations of the human norovirus enteroid system directly, as it focuses on ReCV. However, the evidence is strong, as it demonstrates the successful establishment and characterization of rhesus enteroid models that support ReCV infection.

papers.title_zh: 恒河猴肠道类器官及类器官衍生细胞系用于肠道杯状病毒感染的研究
papers.source_body_en: Recoviruses (ReCV) serve as valuable surrogates for fastidious human noroviruses (HuNoV). Although HuNoVs can be propagated in small intestinal enteroids, this system has several limitations, including low replication efficiency and an inability to sustain continuous propagation for generating infectious virus stocks beyond certain strains, such as GII.3. In contrast, ReCVs can be efficiently propagated in conventional cell lines (e.g., LLC-MK2), which has significantly advanced understanding of their biological characteristics. As a result, ReCVs are widely used as HuNoV surrogates. However, a physiologically relevant ReCV propagation system that closely mimics HuNoV enteroid cultures has not yet been described. Here, we report the establishment of intestinal stem cell-derived rhesus macaque enteroid lines representing both the small intestine and colon, along with two enteroid-derived cell lines. We further characterize these systems and evaluate their susceptibility to infection with three diverse ReCV isolates. Both small intestine- and colon-derived enteroids, as well as their corresponding cell lines, supported robust ReCV infection. The enteroids contained all major intestinal cell types. The duodenum-derived cell line comprised enteroendocrine cells (chromogranin A) and absorptive enterocytes (villin), whereas the colon-derived cell line included enteroendocrine cells and goblet cells (MUC2). Importantly, both cell lines formed tight barriers (transepithelial electrical resistance [TEER] > 3,000 Ω·cm2), making them far superior to LLC-MK2 cells (TEER ~ 100 Ω·cm2) for studies of viral entry and pathogenesis. The rhesus enteroids and intestinal cell lines developed in this study will enable comparative studies of HuNoV and ReCV replication in a physiologically relevant system and may have direct applications for culturing HuNoVs.IMPORTANCEHuman intestinal stem cell-derived enteroids have enabled the propagation of human noroviruses; however, this system has several important limitations, including high cost, low replication efficiency, and (except for a recent report for GII.3 human norovirus) the inability to sustain continuous virus propagation for the generation of infectious virus stocks. As a result, research still relies on human norovirus-containing clinical samples as the primary virus source. Here, we developed host-specific rhesus macaque enteroid cultures and two enteroid-derived cell lines that support robust recovirus replication. Studying recovirus replication in rhesus enteroids may help overcome key limitations of the human norovirus enteroid cultures. Moreover, because both natural and experimental human norovirus infections have been described in rhesus macaques, the rhesus enteroids and enteroid-derived cell lines described in this study may be directly applicable to human norovirus cultivation.
papers.abstract_zh: Recoviruses(ReCV)作为人类难培养诺如病毒(HuNoV)的有价值的替代物。尽管HuNoV可以在小肠类器官中进行培养,但该系统存在一些局限性,包括复制效率低以及无法持续培养以生成某些菌株(如GII.3)的感染性病毒颗粒。相比之下,ReCV可以在常规细胞系(如LLC-MK2)中高效培养,这显著促进了对其生物学特性的理解。因此,ReCV被广泛用作HuNoV的替代物。然而,目前尚未描述一种能与HuNoV肠道类器官培养密切相关的生理相关ReCV培养系统。在此,我们报告了建立代表小肠和结肠的恒河猴肠道干细胞衍生类器官系以及两种类器官衍生细胞系。我们进一步对这些系统进行了表征,并评估了它们对三种不同的ReCV分离株的感染敏感性。无论是小肠还是结肠来源的类器官,以及它们对应的细胞系,都支持了ReCV的强效感染。这些类器官包含了所有主要的肠道细胞类型。来自十二指肠的细胞系包含肠内分泌细胞(染色体颗粒A)和吸收性肠上皮细胞(绒毛蛋白),而来自结肠的细胞系则包含肠内分泌细胞和杯状细胞(MUC2)。重要的是,这两种细胞系均形成了紧密的屏障(跨上皮电阻力[TEER] > 3,000 Ω·cm2),使其在研究病毒入侵和诺如病毒方面远优于LLC-MK2细胞(TEER ~ 100 Ω·cm2)。本研究中开发的恒河猴类器官和肠道细胞系将有助于在生理相关的系统中进行HuNoV和ReCV复制的比较研究,并可能直接应用于HuNoV的培养。重要性:人类肠道干细胞衍生的类器官使人类诺如病毒(HuNoV)的培养成为可能;然而,该系统存在一些重要的局限性,包括成本高、复制效率低,以及(除最近报道的GII.3型HuNoV外)无法持续培养以生成感染性病毒颗粒。因此,研究仍然依赖于含有HuNoV的临床样本作为主要的病毒来源。在此,我们开发了针对ReCV的恒河猴肠道类器官培养系统以及两种类器官衍生细胞系,这些系统支持ReCV的强效复制。研究ReCV在恒河猴类器官中的复制可能有助于克服人类HuNoV类器官培养系统的关键局限性。此外,由于在恒河猴中已经描述了自然和实验性HuNoV感染,本研究中描述的恒河猴类器官和类器官衍生细胞系可能直接适用于HuNoV的培养。

papers.title: Infections and Anti-N-Methyl-D-Aspartate Receptor Encephalitis in Children and Adolescents: A Scoping Review of Evidence Since the COVID-19 Pandemic
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (anti-NMDAR) encephalitis is a common autoimmune encephalitis affecting children and adolescents. Its development has been associated with preceding or concomitant infections, particularly herpes simplex virus type 1 (HSV-1). This scoping review characterized the association between infections and pediatric anti-NMDAR encephalitis, focusing on epidemiology, pathophysiology, clinical presentation, treatment, and prognosis from January 2020 to August 2025. Methods: A scoping review was conducted according to the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) framework. PubMed was systematically searched using the terms NMDAR encephalitis AND infections AND children. Of 110 identified records, 13 studies met the predefined eligibility criteria. Results: HSV-1 was the most consistently reported infectious association, particularly in younger children. Clinical phenotype varied with age, with neurological manifestations predominating in younger children and psychiatric, behavioral, and cognitive symptoms becoming more prominent in adolescents. HSV-associated cases, particularly following extensive HSV-related brain injury, were associated with greater residual neurological morbidity and less favorable long-term outcomes. Other infectious agents, including SARS-CoV-2, respiratory syncytial virus, influenza B, and norovirus, were reported less frequently, with limited evidence regarding their impact on disease course. Immunotherapeutic strategies were generally similar irrespective of preceding infection, although active or treatment-associated infections could influence treatment timing, sequencing, and infectious-risk considerations. Earlier immunotherapy was associated with more favorable neurological recovery. Conclusions: Infectious exposures, particularly HSV-1, appear to be associated with pediatric anti-NMDAR encephalitis, although causality cannot be established from the predominantly retrospective and case-based literature. Prospective, multicenter studies using standardized diagnostic and outcome measures are needed to clarify the infection–autoimmunity relationship and optimize early recognition and management.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目标:抗N-甲基-D-天门冬氨酸受体(anti-NMDAR)脑炎是一种常见的自身免疫性脑炎,影响儿童和青少年。其发病与先前或同时发生的感染有关,尤其是单纯疱疹病毒1型(HSV-1)。本次范围综述旨在描述感染与儿科anti-NMDAR脑炎之间的关联,重点关注流行病学、发病机制、临床表现、治疗以及预后,时间范围为2020年1月至2025年8月。方法:根据Joanna Briggs研究所(JBI)框架进行了范围综述。使用术语NMDAR脑炎 AND 感染 AND 儿童在PubMed上进行了系统性检索。共识别出110条记录,其中13项研究符合预定义的纳入标准。结果:HSV-1是最常被报道的感染关联,尤其是在年幼的儿童中。临床表型随年龄变化,年幼儿童以神经系统表现为主,而青少年则以精神科、行为和认知症状更为突出。与HSV相关的病例,特别是伴随广泛HSV相关脑损伤的病例,与更严重的残留神经系统疾病和较差的长期预后相关。其他感染病原体,包括SARS-CoV-2、呼吸道合胞病毒、流感B型病毒和诺如病毒,报道较少,关于其对疾病进程影响的证据有限。免疫治疗策略通常与先前感染无关,尽管活动性或治疗相关感染可能影响治疗的时间、顺序和感染风险考虑。早期免疫治疗与更良好的神经系统恢复相关。结论:感染暴露,特别是HSV-1,似乎与儿科anti-NMDAR脑炎有关,但由于文献主要为回顾性和病例为基础,无法确立因果关系。需要进行前瞻性、多中心研究,使用标准化的诊断和预后评估方法,以明确感染与自身免疫之间的关系,并优化早期识别和管理。

news.content: |KOREAN National Market & Money Industry North Korea Entertainment+ Lifestyle World Opinion Sports EnglishNational Norovirus Cases Surge 70-Fold in Seoul Summer, Chuseok Alert Issued Summer detections hit 141 cases vs 2 last year; GII.3 strain dominates as health officials urge hygiene during holiday gatherings By Kim Myeong-jin Published 2026.09.25. 11:10Updated 2026.09.28. 10:31 Illustrated by Baek Hyeong-seon Norovirus, which mainly spreads in winter, was detected in 141 cases in Seoul from June to August this year, as revealed on the 25th. This is 70.5 times higher than the two cases detected during the same period last year. According to a source from the Seoul Metropolitan Government Health and Environment Research Institute, monthly norovirus detections this summer were 79 cases in June, 52 cases in July, and 10 cases in August. Last summer, there was one case each in June and August, and none in July. The cumulative detections from January to August this year reached 345 cases, surpassing the total of 242 cases recorded for the entire year last year. Norovirus mainly occurs from November to April, spanning winter and early spring of the following year. Last year, 92 cases were detected in January alone. Infection leads to vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain. It is contracted by consuming contaminated oysters, shellfish, or groundwater, and can also spread through handshakes with an infected person, droplets during conversation, or contact with vomit. Although it is highly contagious, there is no preventive vaccine. Even after recovering once, immunity does not last long, leading to frequent reinfections. /Graphics by Jeong Da-un The types of detected viruses have also changed. Norovirus is classified into various types based on its genotype. The timing and scale of outbreaks depend on which type is prevalent. Among the 345 cases detected from January to August this year, 185 cases (53.6 percent) were of the ‘GII.3’ type, which was not detected at all last year. Park Ju-sung, head of the Seoul Metropolitan Government Health and Environment Research Institute, said, “Unlike previous years, this year has seen a significant increase in norovirus cases even during the summer, indicating changes in the patterns of food poisoning outbreaks,” and added, “We will do our best to create a safe food environment where citizens can feel secure through rapid and accurate testing and identifying the causes.” During the Chuseok holiday, when families and relatives gather and food consumption increases, the risk of group infections rises. The institute urged people to wash their hands with soap for at least 30 seconds before and after cooking, before meals, and after using the bathroom. Meat and seafood should be thoroughly cooked until the center, and particular caution should be exercised with shellfish like oysters. Norovirus is eliminated by heating to 85 degrees Celsius for at least one minute. analysis.time: Norovirus cases surged in Seoul during the summer months of 2026, with the summer period (June to August) reporting 141 cases compared to 2 cases in the same period last year. The cumulative cases from January to August 2026 reached 345, surpassing the total of 242 cases recorded for the entire year in 2025. The Chuseok holiday, which occurs in late September, is highlighted as a period of increased risk due to gatherings and food consumption.
analysis.location_and_population: The outbreak occurred in Seoul, South Korea, affecting the general population, particularly during the Chuseok holiday when family gatherings and food consumption increase. The Seoul Metropolitan Government Health and Environment Research Institute reported the cases.
analysis.event: Norovirus cases surged 70.5 times compared to the previous year during the summer months, with the GII.3 strain dominating. Health officials issued an alert for the Chuseok holiday, emphasizing the need for hygiene measures to prevent group infections.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: The number of cases increased significantly, with 141 cases reported in June to August 2026, compared to 2 cases in the same period last year. The GII.3 strain accounted for 53.6% of the 345 cases detected from January to August 2026. The risk of group infections is heightened during the Chuseok holiday due to increased social interactions and food consumption.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The Seoul Metropolitan Government Health and Environment Research Institute is conducting rapid and accurate testing to identify the causes of the outbreak. They have urged citizens to maintain hygiene, such as washing hands with soap for at least 30 seconds, and to cook food thoroughly, especially shellfish, to prevent further spread. The institute is working to create a safe food environment.

The GII.3 strain dominated the outbreak, accounting for 53.6% of the 345 cases detected from January to August 2026, surpassing the total of 242 cases recorded for the entire year in 2025. The Seoul Metropolitan Government Health and Environment Research Institute emphasized the need for improved hygiene practices, such as washing hands with soap for at least 30 seconds before and after cooking, and thorough cooking of meat and seafood, especially shellfish, to prevent further spread. They are conducting rapid and accurate testing to identify the causes of the outbreak and aim to create a safe food environment for citizens.

elements_en.time: Norovirus cases surged in Seoul during the summer months of 2026, with the summer period (June to August) reporting 141 cases compared to 2 cases in the same period last year. The cumulative cases from January to August 2026 reached 345, surpassing the total of 242 cases recorded for the entire year in 2025. The Chuseok holiday, which occurs in late September, is highlighted as a period of increased risk due to gatherings and food consumption.
elements_en.location_and_population: The outbreak occurred in Seoul, South Korea, affecting the general population, particularly during the Chuseok holiday when family gatherings and food consumption increase. The Seoul Metropolitan Government Health and Environment Research Institute reported the cases.
elements_en.event: Norovirus cases surged 70.5 times compared to the previous year during the summer months, with the GII.3 strain dominating. Health officials issued an alert for the Chuseok holiday, emphasizing the need for hygiene measures to prevent group infections.
elements_en.scale_impact_and_risk: The number of cases increased significantly, with 141 cases reported in June to August 2026, compared to 2 cases in the same period last year. The GII.3 strain accounted for 53.6% of the 345 cases detected from January to August 2026. The risk of group infections is heightened during the Chuseok holiday due to increased social interactions and food consumption.
elements_en.response_status_and_uncertainty: The Seoul Metropolitan Government Health and Environment Research Institute is conducting rapid and accurate testing to identify the causes of the outbreak. They have urged citizens to maintain hygiene, such as washing hands with soap for at least 30 seconds, and to cook food thoroughly, especially shellfish, to prevent further spread. The institute is working to create a safe food environment.

news.title_zh: 诺如病毒病例在首尔夏季激增70倍,中秋警报发布 - chosun.com
news.source_body_en: Norovirus cases in Seoul, South Korea, surged 70.5 times compared to the previous year during the summer months of 2026, with 141 cases reported from June to August, up from 2 cases in the same period in 2025. The GII.3 strain dominated the outbreak, accounting for 53.6% of the 345 cases detected from January to August 2026, surpassing the total of 242 cases recorded for the entire year in 2025. Health officials issued a Chuseok holiday alert, noting that the risk of group infections increases during this time due to family gatherings and food consumption. The Seoul Metropolitan Government Health and Environment Research Institute emphasized the need for improved hygiene practices, such as washing hands with soap for at least 30 seconds before and after cooking, and thorough cooking of meat and seafood, especially shellfish, to prevent further spread. They are conducting rapid and accurate testing to identify the causes of the outbreak and aim to create a safe food environment for citizens.
news.content_zh: 2026年首尔诺如病毒病例在夏季激增70.5倍,6月至8月期间报告了141例病例,而2025年同期仅为2例。GII.3株在诺如病毒中占主导地位,占2026年1月至8月期间检测到的345例病例的53.6%,超过了2025年全年记录的242例病例总数。卫生官员发布了中秋假期警报,指出由于家庭聚会和食物消费,该时期群体感染风险增加。首尔特别市卫生与环境研究院强调需要改进卫生措施,例如在烹饪前后用肥皂洗手至少30秒,以及彻底烹饪肉类和海鲜,尤其是贝类,以防止进一步传播。他们正在开展快速且准确的检测以确定诺如病毒的病因,并致力于为市民创造安全的食品环境。

news.content: PRIVACY User Consent Prompt Focus Prompt PRIVACY Close the sidebar ΠΟΛΙΤΙΚΗ NON PAPER ΕΛΛΑΔΑ ΟΙΚΟΝΟΜΙΑ ΚΟΣΜΟΣ ΠΟΛΙΤΙΣΜΟΣ ΖΩΗ ΣΠΟΡ ΓΥΝΑΙΚΑ ENGLISH EDITION ΠΟΛΗ STORIES ΕΚΛΟΓΕΣ TRAVEL ΤΕΧΝΟΛΟΓΙΑ ΥΓΕΙΑ DESIGN ΠΑΝΕΛΛΗΝΙΕΣ ΟΛΥΜΠΙΑΚΟΙ ΑΓΩΝΕΣ EURO GREEN PODCAST iAUTOKINITO iOPINIONS iGASTRONOMIE iBOOKS ΖΩΔΙΑ OSCARS THE OCEAN MEDIA ELAMEFORA Close the sidebar ENGLISH Norovirus Outbreak in Rhodes Tops 1,400 Cases Since July, Hospital Says Rhodes General Hospital / EUROKINISSI ANTHEE CARASSAVA 28/09/2026 13:35 A highly contagious norovirus is behind more than 1,400 cases of viral gastroenteritis recorded on Rhodes since July, with the island's hospital seeing roughly 40 patients a day at the outbreak's peak in August, before easing to about 30 daily cases in September. Michalis Sokorelos, director of Rhodes General Hospital's medical services, told iefimerida the vast majority of cases have been mild, typically resolving within two to three days at home. Hospitalization was mainly required for elderly patients or those with chronic underlying conditions, who were more likely to develop dehydration. Mr. Sokorelos urged strict adherence to personal hygiene measures and asked residents to remain calm. Symptoms of viral gastroenteritis typically include watery diarrhea and vomiting, sometimes accompanied by nausea, abdominal cramps, headache, muscle aches, fatigue, chills and occasionally low-grade fever. Most cases resolve without medical treatment. Norovirus, the most common cause of viral gastroenteritis, has an incubation period of 24 to 48 hours, with symptoms typically lasting one to three days. The virus spreads primarily through contact with contaminated surfaces or objects, or through contaminated food and water, and is highly transmissible between people. According to Greece's National Public Health Organization (EODY), the country recorded seven norovirus-linked gastroenteritis outbreaks between May and October 2024, compared with an average of one to two annual outbreaks in prior years. Global norovirus infections total roughly 685 million annually, with about 200,000 deaths worldwide, though mortality associated with the illness remains low. news.content: Seoul norovirus detections soar ahead of Chuseok, raising food poisoning risk - CHOSUNBIZ 2026년 9월 30일(수) KR JP 이코노미조선 KR JP Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports EnglishSociety Seoul norovirus detections soar ahead of Chuseok, raising food poisoning risk By Hwang Chae-young Published 2026.09.25. 11:09 Prefer Chosunbiz EN on Google At the Gyeonggi Institute of Health and Environment in Gwonseon-gu, Suwon, Gyeonggi Province, an employee on the waterborne disease team of the Infectious Disease Research Department conducts a culture test for food poisoning bacteria. /Courtesy of News1 Norovirus, which mainly spreads in winter, was detected at an unusually high rate in Seoul this summer. The Seoul Institute of Health and Environment said on the 25th that the number of norovirus detections in Seoul from June to August this year was 141, about 70.5 times higher than the two cases during the same period last year. The cumulative number of detections from January to August this year also reached 345, already surpassing last year's annual total of 242. During the same period, the institute conducted 3,575 tests for viral food poisoning, more than the 3,038 tests conducted in all of last year. Genetic analysis also showed a different pattern from previous years. Unlike last year, the norovirus "GII.3" genotype was found to have increased markedly this year. The institute said sustained monitoring is needed because the pattern differs from the usual winter-concentrated spread of norovirus. Norovirus can spread by consuming contaminated food or water or through contact with an infected person. Caution is needed because the virus can also spread via an infected person's vomit. High-Balance 2-Year CD Yields Returns - Take A Look.TrendingSearch | CD Yields Learn More Undo Extra caution is needed for cluster infections during the Chuseok holiday, when family and relative gatherings and food consumption increase. To prevent infection, wash your hands with soap for at least 30 seconds before and after cooking, before meals, and after using the restroom. Cook meat and seafood thoroughly to the center, and fully heat shellfish such as oysters. Boiling water of uncertain safety is recommended. If you have suspected symptoms such as vomiting or diarrhea, avoid preparing food and reduce contact with others. Park Ju-seong, head of the Seoul Institute of Health and Environment, said, "We will closely monitor the changing patterns of food poisoning, and do our utmost to create a safe food environment where citizens can feel at ease through swift and accurate testing and identification of causes." ※ This article has been translated by AI. analysis_zh.response_status_and_uncertainty: 首尔环境与健康研究所强调,由于异常传播模式,需要持续监测。他们正在进行检测并查明原因,以创建安全的食物环境。文章还提到了一般的预防措施。

Health officials confirm norovirus outbreak at Brock University in St. Catharines, Ont. Posted:September 24, 2026 | 3:30 PM By: Julia Vellucci By:Julia Vellucci Co-author:Eric Vienneau Updated: September 25, 2026 | 9:05 AM Make us a preferred source on Google × A photo of Brock University. (Eric Vienneau/CHCH News) Share this story... A+A- Niagara Region Public Health has confirmed through laboratory testing that norovirus is the cause of the gastrointestinal symptoms some Brock University students have been experiencing. It did not provide any information on the scope of the outbreak or how many students were affected. However, the university says that cases are decreasing. People posted on a Brock University Reddit Board that they got sick after eating food at their residence. One user said there were “floors of puking kids.” “I felt like it was scary, especially since school is really busy and it’s probably mostly first years. They don’t wanna be dealing with sickness and missing class because of that, so I felt really bad,” a student said. The health agency says norovirus spreads easily from person-to-person and can cause symptoms such as vomiting, diarrhea, nausea and stomach cramps. The university says its dining halls remain fully operational with enhanced cleaning measures and limited self-serve options to help restrict the spread of viral illness. READ MORE: Niagara Region Public Health investigating after reports of stomach bug ‘cluster’ at Brock University It says increased disinfecting and targeted cleaning are also still in effect within residences. Health officials say the most effective way to limit the spread of norovirus is through frequent and thorough handwashing, especially before eating and handling food as well as before entering the dining halls and after using the bathroom. Students are advised to frequently clean and disinfect shared spaces and high-touch surfaces, including doorknobs and shared bathrooms, using a cleaner that contains bleach. Students who are experiencing symptoms of norovirus are instructed to drink fluids and avoid large gatherings. Public Health is actively tracking symptom patterns, timing and lab results. Symptoms can be reported directly to them at inspect@niagararegion.ca. analysis.brief_en: Health officials have confirmed a norovirus outbreak at Brock University in St. Catharines, Ontario, Canada, following laboratory testing. The outbreak was initially reported on September 24, 2026, and confirmed on September 25, 2026. While the exact number of affected students is not disclosed, the university noted that cases are decreasing. Symptoms include vomiting, diarrhea, nausea, and stomach cramps, and the virus spreads easily from person-to-person. Public Health is tracking symptom patterns and lab results to manage the situation. In response, the university has implemented enhanced cleaning measures in dining halls and residences, limiting self-serve options. Students are advised to practice frequent handwashing, especially before eating and after using the bathroom, and to clean shared spaces with bleach-containing products. Those experiencing symptoms are instructed to drink fluids and avoid large gatherings. The outbreak highlights the need for vigilance in preventing the spread of norovirus in communal settings.

Students are advised to practice frequent handwashing, especially before eating and after using the bathroom, and to clean shared spaces with bleach-containing products. Those experiencing symptoms are instructed to drink fluids and avoid large gatherings. The outbreak highlights the need for vigilance in preventing the spread of norovirus in communal settings.

Show original New Strategy for Attenuated Vaccines Opened by Decoding Norovirus RNA Structure 1 バイオアソシエイツ生命科学出版部 2026年9月24日 22:44 This article summarizes the key points of the article "Decoding Norovirus RNA Structure: A New Strategy for Targeted Attenuation," published on "BioMarket jp," a news site reporting on the latest research trends in global biotechnology. You can quickly grasp the overview of the research that decoded the genomic RNA structure of the norovirus. Summary of Points 👉 Background: There are no effective treatments or vaccines for norovirus, and research has long been stagnant because human norovirus is difficult to culture. 👉 Discovery: The research team decoded the entire viral genome RNA structure within infected cells for the first time, revealing that more than half of the genome forms a stable three-dimensional structure. 👉 Future: It has been shown that by targeting this RNA structure, genetically stable attenuated viruses can be designed, and applications to other RNA viruses are also expected. Long-standing barriers in norovirus research Despite being a major cause of gastrointestinal disease worldwide, there are no effective treatments or vaccines for norovirus. Research has long been stagnant because human norovirus is difficult to culture, and there is a lack of genetic analysis tools and suitable animal models. It has been pointed out that viral RNA may contain control information in its three-dimensional structure itself, but the actual state within infected cells had not been understood until now. The "shape" of the genome decoded within infected cells The research team used mouse norovirus, which is easier to handle genetically, to decode the three-dimensional structure of the entire viral genome within infected cells for the first time. Advertisement Norovirus confirmed as cause of outbreak that sickened 60 after Orange County emergency drill County officials, law enforcement, emergency management and other agencies took part in the large-scale exercise in Goshen. Blaise Gomez • Sep 24, 2026, 9:19 AM • Updated 5 days ago Share: More Stories Paddington Bear doll lost at Bradley Int’l Airport to be reunited with owner Fallen tree causes traffic trouble during commute near Yonkers school 01:58 Feeding Westchester highlights fight against hunger on Hunger Action Day Police: Yonkers man fatally stabs father Giants release receiver Odell Beckham Jr. after three games and zero catches 00:43 Nyack honors longtime pharmacist Jerry Koblin with street dedication The Orange County Department of Health has confirmed that norovirus caused an outbreak that sickened 60 people following an emergency preparedness drill earlier this month. News 12 first reported that people became sick after attending the Sept. 9 event at the county’s Emergency Management facility in Goshen. County health officials said 119 people who responded to a survey reported eating at the event, and 60 of them — just over 50% — became ill. Several people sought medical care, but no one was hospitalized. The county said several people who became sick also provided specimens for testing. All of those samples tested positive for norovirus. Health officials said norovirus was “very likely” the cause of the outbreak. Must Watch The county’s epidemiological investigation is ongoing. While testing confirmed norovirus among those who submitted specimens, the county has not said whether investigators have determined how the virus spread or whether a specific food or drink was responsible. The large-scale emergency exercise brought together county officials, law enforcement, emergency management personnel and other agencies to practice their response to a simulated hurricane, flooding and building collapse. Norovirus is a highly contagious virus that causes inflammation of the stomach and intestines. It can spread through direct contact with an infected person, by eating contaminated food or drinking contaminated liquids, or by touching contaminated surfaces and then putting unwashed hands near the mouth. People can continue spreading the virus even after they begin feeling better, and it can remain on surfaces. Health officials said norovirus cases typically begin increasing around this time of year and continue through the spring. Symptoms can include vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, nausea, fever, headaches and body aches. Symptoms generally develop 12 to 48 hours after exposure. Officials also warn that hand sanitizer alone does not kill norovirus. They recommend frequent handwashing with soap and water for at least 20 seconds and properly cleaning and disinfecting surfaces. analysis.location_and_population: The outbreak occurred in Orange County, specifically at the county’s Emergency Management facility in Goshen. It affected 60 people who attended the emergency drill (N3, N7, N8).
analysis.event: Norovirus was confirmed as the cause of an outbreak that sickened 60 people following an emergency preparedness drill in Orange County (N5, N6, N7).
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: 60 individuals became ill after attending the event, with no hospitalizations reported. The county health officials stated that norovirus was 'very likely' the cause, but the exact transmission route remains under investigation (N5, N8, N14).
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The county’s epidemiological investigation is ongoing. Testing confirmed norovirus among those who submitted specimens, but the source of the outbreak and specific transmission routes have not been identified (N13, N14, N15).

analysis.brief_en: In September 2026, an outbreak of norovirus sickened 60 people after an emergency preparedness drill in Orange County, New York, held at the Emergency Management facility in Goshen. The Orange County Department of Health confirmed the norovirus as the cause, based on testing of specimens from affected individuals. While 60 people reported illness, no hospitalizations were noted. The investigation into how the virus spread is ongoing, with health officials indicating that norovirus is 'very likely' responsible. The drill simulated hurricane, flooding, and building collapse scenarios, bringing together county officials, law enforcement, and emergency management personnel. Norovirus is known to spread through direct contact, contaminated food or liquids, and surfaces, and officials emphasize the importance of thorough handwashing and surface disinfection. The outbreak highlights the potential for norovirus to spread in large gatherings, even during emergency exercises.

news.title_zh: 诺如病毒被确认为导致暴发的病原体,该疫情在纽约橙县应急演练后感染60人 - 新闻12 - 荷兰河谷
news.source_body_en: In September 2026, an outbreak of norovirus sickened 60 people after an emergency preparedness drill in Orange County, New York, held at the Emergency Management facility in Goshen. The Orange County Department of Health confirmed the norovirus as the cause, based on testing of specimens from affected individuals. While 60 people reported illness, no hospitalizations were noted. The investigation into how the virus spread is ongoing, with health officials indicating that norovirus is 'very likely' responsible. The drill simulated hurricane, flooding, and building collapse scenarios, bringing together county officials, law enforcement, and emergency management personnel. Norovirus is known to spread through direct contact, contaminated food or liquids, and surfaces, and officials emphasize the importance of thorough handwashing and surface disinfection. The outbreak highlights the potential for norovirus to spread in large gatherings, even during emergency exercises.
news.content_zh: 2026年9月,纽约橙县在戈申的应急管理局设施举行了一次应急准备演练,随后发生了一起暴发疫情,感染了60人。橙县卫生部门确认诺如病毒是此次疫情的病原体,依据对受影响个体样本的检测结果。虽然有60人报告患病,但未出现住院病例。关于病毒传播途径的调查仍在进行中,卫生官员表示诺如病毒‘很可能’是疫情的根源。此次演练模拟了飓风、洪水和建筑物倒塌等场景,召集了县官员、执法部门和应急管理人员。诺如病毒已知通过直接接触、受污染的食物或液体以及表面传播,官员强调了彻底洗手和表面消毒的重要性。此次暴发事件凸显了诺如病毒在大型聚集活动中的传播潜力,即使是在应急演练期间也是如此。
news.summary_zh: 2026年9月,纽约橙县在戈申的应急管理局设施举行了一次应急准备演练,随后发生了一起暴发疫情,感染了60人。橙县卫生部门确认诺如病毒是此次疫情的病原体,依据对受影响个体样本的检测结果。虽然有60人报告患病,但未出现住院病例。关于病毒传播途径的调查仍在进行中,卫生官员表示诺如病毒‘很可能’是疫情的根源。此次演练模拟了飓风、洪水和建筑物倒塌等场景,召集了县官员、执法部门和应急管理人员。诺如病毒已知通过直接接触、受污染的食物或液体以及表面传播,官员强调了彻底洗手和表面消毒的重要性。此次暴发事件凸显了诺如病毒在大型聚集活动中的传播潜力,即使是在应急演练期间也是如此。

analysis_zh.time: 暴发 在2026年9月的应急演练后被确认发生,发表日期为2026-09-24。事件日期未明确说明,但据报道该事件发生在本月早些时候(N5,N6,N7)。
analysis_zh.location_and_population: 该暴发事件发生在纽约橙县,具体地点为该县戈申的应急管理局设施。共有60人参加了此次应急演练而受到影响(N3,N7,N8)。
analysis_zh.event: 诺如病毒被确认为导致一起暴发疫情的病原体,该疫情在橙县的一次应急准备演练后感染了60人(N5,N6,N7)。
analysis_zh.scale_impact_and_risk: 60名参加活动的个体出现患病症状,但未有住院病例报告。县卫生官员表示诺如病毒‘很可能’是疫情的根源,但具体的传播途径仍在调查中(N5,N8,N14)。
analysis_zh.response_status_and_uncertainty: 该县的流行病学调查仍在进行中。检测确认了诺如病毒在提交样本的个体中存在,但疫情的源头和具体的传播途径尚未明确(N13,N14,N15)。

news.wechat_summary_zh: 时间：暴发 在2026年9月的应急演练后被确认发生，发表日期为2026-09-24。事件日期未明确说明，但据报道该事件发生在本月早些时...；地点与对象：该暴发事件发生在纽约橙县，具体地点为该县戈申的应急管理局设施。共有60人参加了此次应急演练而受到影响(N3，N7，N8)。；事件：诺如病毒被确认为导致一起暴发疫情的病原体，该疫情在橙县的一次应急准备演练后感染了60人(N5，N6，N7)。；影响与风险：60名参加活动的个体出现患病症状，但未有住院病例报告。县卫生官员表示诺如病毒‘很可能’是疫情的根源，但具体的传播途径仍在调查中(N5，N8，N14)。；应对与不确定性：该县的流行病学调查仍在进行中。检测确认了诺如病毒在提交样本的个体中存在，但疫情的源头和具体的传播途径尚未明确(N13，N14，N15)。

Play Video Article content The Summerhill Market brand raspberries, as well as the stores’ frozen berry mix, frozen smoothie mix, and raspberry protein powder were sold at all six of their locations: 446 Summerhill Ave., 3609 Dundas St. W., 484 Eglinton Ave. W., 1054 Mount Pleasant Rd. and 1014 Bathurst St. in Toronto; and 32 Wellington St. W. in Aurora. The products were sold between July 29, 2026 and Sept. 15, 2026, the Canadian Food Inspection Agency said in a notice on Tuesday. The recall was triggered during the CFIA’s investigation into a foodborne illness outbreak, officials said, but noted that there have been no reported illnesses linked to the consumption of the raspberry products. This comes after another brand of frozen raspberries, from Alasko, were recalled in seven provinces — including Ontario — over similar norovirus concerns. Norovirus is a highly contagious that causes diarrhea and vomiting, according to Health Canada. Symptoms of gastroenteritis typically develop within 24 to 48 hours, but can start as early as 12 hours of exposure. “The illness often begins suddenly,” the CFIA noted, adding that even after having the illness, you can still become re-infected by norovirus. Summerhill Market’s frozen smoothie mix and raspberry protein power pod. Canadian Food Inspection Agency What are the symptoms? The main symptoms of norovirus illness are diarrhea, vomiting (children usually experience more vomiting than adults), nausea and stomach cramps. Other symptoms may include low-grade fever, headache, chills, muscle aches and fatigue. The CFIA suggested that those experiencing the symptoms should stay hydrated. Most people feel better within one or two days, with symptoms resolving on their own, and experience no long-term health effects. In “severe cases,” however, some individuals “may need to be hospitalized and given fluids intravenously,” according to the notice. Recalled products should be thrown out or returned to the location where they were purchased. The CFIA is verifying that all recalled products are removed from the marketplace. The agency added that its food safety investigation continues and could lead to the recall of other products. RECOMMENDED VIDEO We apologize, but this video has failed to load. analysis.time: The recall was announced on September 29, 2026, with the products sold between July 29, 2026, and September 15, 2026.
analysis.location_and_population: The products were sold at Summerhill Market locations in Toronto and at 32 Wellington St. in Ottawa, affecting consumers in these areas.
analysis.event: Summerhill Market's frozen raspberries and frozen berry mix were recalled due to possible norovirus contamination, as reported by the Canadian Food Inspection Agency (CFIA).
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: The recall involves multiple products, including frozen raspberries, frozen berry mix, frozen smoothie mix, and raspberry protein powder. No reported illnesses have been linked to the consumption of these products, but the CFIA is investigating a foodborne illness outbreak.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The recall was triggered during the CFIA’s investigation into a foodborne illness outbreak. The agency has issued a notice, but no confirmed cases or illnesses have been reported yet. The status remains under investigation.

analysis.brief_en: On September 29, 2026, the Canadian Food Inspection Agency (CFIA) announced a recall of Summerhill Market's frozen raspberries and frozen berry mix due to possible norovirus contamination. The products were sold between July 29, 2026, and September 15, 2026, at all six of Summerhill Market's locations in Toronto and at 32 Wellington St. in Ottawa. The recall was initiated as part of an investigation into a foodborne illness outbreak, though no illnesses have been directly linked to the raspberry products. The CFIA emphasized that the recall is precautionary, and the status of the investigation remains under review. Consumers are advised to stop using the recalled products immediately. This action follows a similar recall of frozen raspberries from another brand, Alasko, in seven provinces, including Ontario, over norovirus concerns.
analysis.summary_en: On September 29, 2026, the Canadian Food Inspection Agency (CFIA) announced a recall of Summerhill Market's frozen raspberries and frozen berry mix due to possible norovirus contamination. news.content: WhatsApp Home Daily Culture Sport Media GIBRALTAR · 30 SEPT 2026 · 02:27| ☀️ 21,0°C · 1,4 m/s YesterdaySNDO Delivers Accessibility Training For Government Staff And Architects YesterdayExhibition of Comics by Joseph Piñero Opens at GEMA Gallery YesterdayMinister Arias-Vasquez Meets UK Prime Minister In Liverpool MonNew Single By Gabriel Moreno: Layers MonDelivery.gi Holds Piazza Pop-up In Support Of Cancer Relief MonGibraltar Darts Heads To Europe Cup MonKing Charles Sends Best Wishes To Gibraltar MonBusiness Transition Group Meets As Treaty Changes Bed In YesterdaySNDO Delivers Accessibility Training For Government Staff And Architects YesterdayExhibition of Comics by Joseph Piñero Opens at GEMA Gallery YesterdayMinister Arias-Vasquez Meets UK Prime Minister In Liverpool MonNew Single By Gabriel Moreno: Layers MonDelivery.gi Holds Piazza Pop-up In Support Of Cancer Relief MonGibraltar Darts Heads To Europe Cup MonKing Charles Sends Best Wishes To Gibraltar MonBusiness Transition Group Meets As Treaty Changes Bed In Daily GHA Issues Norovirus Advice By YGTV Newsroom6 months ago2 min read Public Health says it is aware of an increase in people in the community suffering from rapid onset diarrhoea and/or vomiting. The GHA is requesting that if you experience diarrhoea or vomiting, please do not go and visit your family or friends in hospital or ERS until 48 hours after your symptoms have stopped. A statement from the GHA follows below: Public Health are aware of an increase in people in the community suffering from rapid onset diarrhoea and/or vomiting. This is most likely due to norovirus, or the winter vomiting bug. This is typically a short-lived illness and although unpleasant, most people make a full recovery without needing medical care. The GHA is requesting that if you experience diarrhoea or vomiting, please do not go and visit your family or friends in hospital or ERS until 48 hours after your symptoms have stopped. If you are due to attend an outpatient appointment or radiology appointment such as breast screening and have had symptoms in the last 48 hours, please contact the relevant department, advise them that you are unwell and they will help to re-schedule your appointment. If you are concerned about your symptoms, please call 111 for advice. Director of Public Health, Dr Helen Carter, said: “Please do not visit your friends or family in hospital or ERS until 48 hours after your symptoms have stopped. The reason this is important is because norovirus is very infectious and you may pass the infection onto patients and staff. “The same advice applies to children returning to school. If they have had diarrhoea or vomiting, they should also remain at home until 48 hours after their symptoms have stopped, in order to help reduce further spread in the community. “Hand washing is essential to prevent the spread of this norovirus. Do not rely on using alcohol hand gels because these do not work for norovirus.”

This is most likely due to norovirus, or the winter vomiting bug. This is typically a short-lived illness and although unpleasant, most people make a full recovery without needing medical care. The GHA is requesting that if you experience diarrhoea or vomiting, please do not go and visit your family or friends in hospital or ERS until 48 hours after your symptoms have stopped. If you are due to attend an outpatient appointment or radiology appointment such as breast screening and have had symptoms in the last 48 hours, please contact the relevant department, advise them that you are unwell and they will help to re-schedule your appointment. If you are concerned about your symptoms, please call 111 for advice. Director of Public Health, Dr Helen Carter, said: “Please do not visit your friends or family in hospital or ERS until 48 hours after your symptoms have stopped. The reason this is important is because norovirus is very infectious and you may pass the infection onto patients and staff. “The same advice applies to children returning to school. If they have had diarrhoea or vomiting, they should also remain at home until 48 hours after their symptoms have stopped, in order to help reduce further spread in the community. “Hand washing is essential to prevent the spread of this norovirus. Do not rely on using alcohol hand gels because these do not work for norovirus.”

analysis.brief_en: Summerhill Market in Toronto, Canada, has initiated a recall of raspberry products due to concerns about possible norovirus contamination. The recall was reported by the Toronto Star on September 29, 2026. However, the evidence does not provide specific details about the number of cases, deaths, or exposures related to this incident. It also lacks information on the investigation status, testing procedures, or any explicit risk assessment. The action taken by the market suggests a precautionary measure, but without further data, the exact health impact or risk level remains unclear. This event highlights the importance of food safety protocols and the potential for viral contamination in food products, though no confirmed or detailed analysis of the norovirus presence or its effects on the population is available in the provided evidence.

news.title_zh: 2026年9月29日,CTV新闻报道,由于可能存在的诺如病毒污染,夏米希尔市场销售的冷冻覆盆子产品被召回。
news.source_body_en: CTV News reported on September 29, 2026, that frozen raspberry products sold at Summerhill Market have been recalled due to possible norovirus contamination. The recall is a precautionary action taken by the market to ensure consumer safety. However, the evidence does not provide specific details about the number of cases, deaths, or exposures related to this contamination. The situation is under investigation, and no explicit risk level or health impact has been confirmed. The article highlights the potential for norovirus contamination in food products but does not elaborate on the scope or consequences of the outbreak. The source_assessment is considered reputable media, and the confidence level is moderate due to the lack of detailed information on the health impact and the nature of the recall being a precautionary measure.
news.content_zh: 2026年9月29日,CTV新闻报道,由于可能存在的诺如病毒污染,夏米希尔市场销售的冷冻覆盆子产品被召回。市场采取了预防性措施以确保消费者安全。然而,证据并未提供关于此次污染导致的具体病例、死亡或暴露数量的详细信息。该情况正在调查中,尚未确认具体的风险水平或健康影响。文章强调了食品中可能存在诺如病毒污染的可能性,但未详细说明暴发污染的范围及其后果。来源评估认为该媒体具有可信度,但由于缺乏关于健康影响的详细信息以及召回措施的预防性质,信心水平为中等。

analysis.brief_en: On September 29, 2026, CP24 reported that frozen raspberry products sold at Summerhill Market in Toronto have been recalled after authorities flagged possible norovirus contamination. The recall was announced without details on the number of affected consumers or specific health outcomes. No case counts, deaths, or exposure figures were provided in the report, and no further information about testing, isolation, or contact tracing was included. Authorities have not disclosed how many consumers may have been exposed, nor have they reported any illnesses linked to the product. The recall remains in effect pending further investigation, and consumers are advised to check purchased items and seek medical attention if symptoms develop.

Authorities have not disclosed how many consumers may have been exposed, nor have they reported any illnesses linked to the product. supplementary_news.content: bpn.ge 29 Sep 30 Sep USD 2.6055 2.6051 EUR 2.9632 2.9552 RUB 3.0866 3.0921 Eng Geo Rus Wed / 30 Sep / 2026 00:29:45 Home Politics Economics Region Military Matters Culture Society Conflicts Justice World Sport Other Announcements Interview Opinion Politics 24.09.2026 / 09:34 a a Tbilisi Deputy Mayor Kakha Abuladze: Norovirus entered kindergartens from outside According to Tbilisi Deputy Mayor Kakha Abuladze, it is established that norovirus entered the city’s kindergartens “from outside.” Speaking on the First Channel, Abuladze said it had been confirmed that the illness among children at kindergartens was caused by a virus rather than food poisoning. “The cause of the illness has already been established. The National Center for Disease Control issued its first statement on September 20, linking the children’s illnesses with a high probability to norovirus. Then, on September 22, it was confirmed that it was norovirus. On the same day, the National Food Agency reported that around 80 samples had been examined, that the studies were ongoing, and that this was not a food-related incident. The fact is that this virus entered the kindergartens from outside. We are also waiting for the investigation to be completed so that we can determine exactly where the infection originated. We fully understand the parents as well, because this issue was particularly sensitive for us until the cause was established. There is no doubt that we are dealing with a virus, which does not surprise us. Both spring and this period of autumn are usually times when viruses become more prevalent,” the Tbilisi Deputy Mayor said. According to him, norovirus has not been limited to kindergartens, and people from other groups of the population have also been seeking medical care for the virus. “It should also be noted that those infected were not only children attending our public kindergartens. We have information that there were other infected patients as well, including a teacher. We are in communication with many practicing doctors, and this is not an issue limited to kindergartens.
